name: Cloudflare Turnstile
description: Adds Cloudflare Turnstile as a CAPTCHA option.
project_description:
Back to top 

 INTRODUCTION 
 The Cloudflare Turnstile module uses the Turnstile web service to augment the CAPTCHA system and protect forms. For more information on what Turnstile is, please visit:

 https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile 

 This module will add functionality to the CAPTCHA module to support Cloudflare's Turnstile product.

 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 
 Turnstile module depends on the CAPTCHA module 
 
 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 
 Enable Cloudflare Turnstile and CAPTCHA modules on:
admin/modules 
 
 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 
 You'll now find a Turnstile tab on the CAPTCHA administration page available at:
admin/config/people/captcha/turnstile 
 Register on:
 Cloudflare 
 Input the site and secret keys into the Cloudflare settings. 
 Visit the CAPTCHA administration page and set where you want the Turnstile form to be presented:
admin/config/people/captcha 
 
 Back to top 

 THANK YOU 
 
 Thank you goes to the Cloudflare team for all their help, support and their amazing CAPTCHA replacement. 

 Back to top
